title: Highlighted starting rates in the website description
summary: Updated the homepage search, social sharing, and structured-data descriptions to state: Comfort Moving Chicago: Rates start at $135 per hour for two movers and a truck.
impact: Gives prospective customers a clear starting price when previewing the homepage in search results or shared links.

title: Paused new job requests across customer forms
summary: Replaced all 23 customer quote and pickup forms with a notice that Comfort Moving Chicago is not accepting new jobs at this time. Updated the form-card headings and removed unused submission scripts from those pages.
impact: Makes the booking pause clear at every customer lead form and stops those forms from collecting new job requests.
ownerNote: The careers application remains available; this change pauses customer job requests.

title: Reopened customer quote and pickup forms
summary: Removed the booking pause notices and restored all 23 customer quote and pickup forms and their CRM submission scripts.
impact: Customers can once again submit new job requests through the website.

title: Moved the website to Cloudflare Workers
summary: Moved the live domain from GitHub Pages to Cloudflare Workers and verified HTTPS, existing page URLs, and the redirect from www.
impact: Existing search and customer links continue working on the new host.
ownerNote: Google Workspace mail and verification DNS records were preserved. Production releases use npm run deploy.

title: Prepared a cleaner website and step-by-step quote form
summary: Migrated the site build to Astro, refreshed the shared navigation and homepage, and broke customer quote and pickup forms into short steps.
impact: Makes the site easier to browse and lets customers request a quote with either a phone number or email.
ownerNote: The Astro branch is ready for review. Include this entry in the owner report after the production release.

title: Simplified the first step of the quote form
summary: The three slides collect contact and service information, then timing and locations, then move details and the required referral source.
impact: The quote card holds its height between slides, with the buttons directly below each slide’s fields.
ownerNote: This change is available on the Astro branch for review.

title: Refined the homepage layout and aligned the starting rate
summary: Grouped trust indicators under the hero, refined the homepage layout, and updated the visible starting rate to $135 per hour for two movers and a truck.
impact: Visitors can scan service options and find answers more easily using the existing site content.
ownerNote: Available on the Astro branch for review.

title: Used a consistent off-white background across the site
summary: Extended the off-white background from the homepage's Simple, No Surprises section to the header and light page sections.
impact: The website has a consistent background across page types.
ownerNote: Available on the Astro branch for review.

title: Capture leads after the contact step
summary: The quote form sends contact info when a visitor chooses to continue. Finishing the remaining steps adds the move details to the same CRM lead.
impact: The team can follow up with visitors who send their contact details and leave before finishing the quote form.
ownerNote: Deploy the matching CRM intake function before publishing this change.

title: Keep quote navigation responsive while saving contact info
summary: The contact step moves straight to the next step while saving in the background. The final step shows Submitting and displays a click-to-call alert if the request cannot be confirmed.
impact: Customers can finish the form without an interruption and get a direct way to reach the team if submission fails.

title: Feature hoisting and fix the quote confirmation footer
summary: Furniture hoisting has a primary navigation link and a dedicated card near the top of the Services page. The thank-you footer reaches the bottom of the viewport on tall screens.
impact: Customers can find hoisting directly from the header or service directory, and the quote confirmation fills the screen.

title: Placed hoisting in the Services dropdown
summary: Removed the standalone Hoisting header link. Furniture hoisting is listed in the Services dropdown on desktop and mobile.
impact: Keeps moving services together in the navigation.

title: Refined the homepage using the Move Sharks layout
summary: Added a consistent content grid, a compact hero and quote card, a connected services directory, and simpler page sections using existing homepage copy.
impact: Makes the homepage easier to scan and brings moving services directly below the quote section.
ownerNote: Available on the Astro branch for review.

title: Redirected old search URLs to their current pages
summary: Added permanent redirects for eight retired URLs found in Search Console, including the old hoisting and blog links.
impact: Visitors following older links reach the matching page or sitemap instead of a 404.
ownerNote: Live on comfortmovingchicago.com as of November 20.

title: Improved the homepage layout below the quote form
summary: Aligned section headings, cards, and actions to one grid. Tightened spacing, clarified service and pricing copy, and simplified the reviews, FAQs, and service-area lists.
impact: Visitors can scan moving services, pricing, reviews, and coverage more easily on desktop and mobile.
ownerNote: Live on comfortmovingchicago.com as of November 20.

title: Applied brand orange to the homepage and refreshed reviewer avatars

title: Moved homepage reviews directly below moving services

title: Restored five old blog links and stabilized mobile page loading

title: Clarified the homepage search description and apartment-moving copy

ownerNote: Published and verified on comfortmovingchicago.com on November 20.
